rule: Physical MatrixCore artifacts are hidden from Gleebs' Dimension Archive. HoloMap, HoloTactics, HoloCore, Mirror's Limbo, Vector Arena, Glyphbound, Utopia Conflict, The Indigo Giant and Afterlife of IO are archive-only realities and must not be represented by hub artifacts.
bot_hosted_rule: Pass 282.56-58: a reality a region guide hosts leaves Gleebs' Dimension Archive and its observatory orbs; the guide's dialogue (and gate) is its entrance. Gleebs keeps the rest at the hub.
